p: blemish: You shall not serve God for selfish means as the hypocrites do.
woman: Showing that the crime cannot be excused by the frailty of the person.
commanded: By which he condemns all religion and serving of God which God has not commanded.
witnesses shall be first upon him: By which they declared that they testify the truth.
people: To signify a common consent to maintain God's honour and true religion.
judge that shall be in those: Who will sentence as the priests counsel him by the Law of God.
thou shalt do: You shall obey their sentence that the controversy may have an end.
minister there before the LORD thy: So long as he is the true minister of God, and pronounces according to his word.
stranger over thee: Who is not from your nation, lest he change true religion into idolatry, and bring you to slavery.
Egypt: To avenge their injuries and to take their best horses from them; 1Ki 10:28.
turn not away: From the Law of God.
law in a book out of: Meaning, Deuteronomy.
priests the Levites: He shall cause it to be written by them, or he shall write it by their example.
brethren: By which is meant that kings should love their subjects as nature causes one brother to love another.
